source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This landing captures the password URI and normalized name before unInit deletes protocol state. It then removes the account/plugin/contact/preference state without spinning an event loop and starts _removePasswordInternal separately. The inspected service and mail bridge call this synchronous deletion path; they do not receive its login-removal promise. Account removal and the later login-store operation therefore have distinct local completion boundaries. The new browser task checks final account/login values, but its microtask cleanup and timed dialog steps do not prove a general scheduling guarantee. No test or login-store failure was run.
title: Chat account deletion separates account teardown from login-store completion
